questions.question: Through the prophet Isaiah, God warned that He would take away what from Jerusalem and Judah?

answers.text: The whole supply of food and water
All the gold in the treasury

questions.question: Isaiah said Jerusalem had stumbled and Judah had fallen. Why did this happen?

answers.text: They spoke and acted against the LORD
Their armies were too small to win
Their walls were not strong enough

questions.question: When God warned Jerusalem and Judah of judgment, what did He say to tell the righteous?

answers.text: It will be well with them
They will fall with the rest

questions.question: In Isaiah's warning to Jerusalem and Judah, who did the LORD bring His charge against?

answers.text: The elders and leaders of His people
The kings of the nations around Judah
The priests who serve in the temple
